heard: Did you know a fish carved this circle? Off southern Japan, a male pufferfish about 4 inches long builds a nest over 6 feet wide. Watch his fins. He swims toward the center, kicking sand to either side. One pass cuts a groove. Hundreds of passes leave a ring of ridges. If a female chooses this nest, she lays her eggs in the middle. Can you spot him now?
